component.name: ModLoader64
component.summary: ModLoader64 is a network capable mod loading system for Nintendo 64 games

description.p: ModLoader64 is an advanced modding platform and online multiplayer framework built around Mupen64Plus. It enables rich scripting, memory injection, and synchronised multiplayer gameplay for Nintendo 64 games such as The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time and Majora's Mask.

ul.li: Built-in online multiplayer netplay and room management
Extensible TypeScript/JavaScript modding and plugin API
Bundled Mupen64Plus emulator with modern graphics, audio, input, and RSP plugins
Integrated GUI for configuring ROMs, game cores, and community mods

description.p: Stable release featuring launcher updates, improved multiplayer sync, and UI fixes.
